title: Subscribe directly through Barkbox
text: We were subscribed to Barkbox for about 2 years. We were pretty happy with the variety but we unsubscribed for a while because the dogs just had too many toys. When I saw the discounted first box on Amazon, we decided to subscribe. I received a duplicate box on my 3rd month. The exact same contents, not just the same theme. Amazon customer service is not helpful and the only thing I can do is return for a refund with no replacement. Plus we have to go to UPS while in a pandemic because there's no option for pickup. Barkbox would have just sent me a new box with no return required. So I am cancelling through Amazon and re-subscribing through Barkbox directly
label: negative
